summary.linux_lane: not run on host (macOS); Linux-only tests require CI or Linux host

findings.description: test_support::temp_dir returned uncreated paths; callers had to create_dir_all manually
findings.disposition: fixed: renamed to unused_temp_path with non-existence contract; ALL created-workspace fixtures migrated to tempfile::tempdir() with owned cleanup; remaining 3 uses (validate_dangerous_project, output_defaults, output_overrides) are genuine uncreated-path contracts

findings.description: Hardcoded /tmp/ paths in test files
findings.disposition: fixed: all hardcoded /tmp/ paths removed and replaced with tempfile::tempdir() or unused_temp_path

findings.description: exists()/is_file()/is_dir() mask IO errors as absence
findings.disposition: fixed: test_fs helpers use symlink_metadata; all negative exists() assertions in build_orchestration_tests, build_cleanup_tests, check_tests, and cli_tests migrated to assert_path_missing; fixture discovery uses symlink_metadata with fail-closed on metadata errors

findings.description: Broad is_err()/error_count()>0 assertions accept wrong failure at multi-lane boundaries
findings.disposition: fixed: all 26 broad is_err() assertions in build_orchestration_tests.rs migrated to assert_output_rejection with typed OutputRejectionReason metadata; benchmark seed tests use specific error message assertions; typed reason seam added to production writer via OutputRejectionReason enum and file_error_with_rejection_reason

findings.description: first_infrastructure_error_for_tests only returned the first infrastructure error
findings.disposition: fixed: infrastructure_errors_for_tests() iterator scans all error diagnostics

findings.description: WarningBuilder created StringId from fresh StringTable; CaseExecutionResult had impossible states
findings.disposition: fixed: WarningBuilder uses active string_table; CaseExecutionResult constructors removed from production; runner tests use panic_if_called; terse_reporting uses valid BuildResult and CompilerMessages in all synthetic fixtures

findings.description: CurrentDirGuard::Drop discarded restoration failures
findings.disposition: fixed: Option<PathBuf> take pattern prevents double-restore; finish() returns Result; Drop panics on restore failure (non-unwinding) or reports to stderr (unwinding); restore-failure injection seam with test_restore; regression tests for both finish-error and unwind-report paths
